page.title: Grants & Rules
page.purpose: Let the minter issue tokens and declare the rules that outlive the issuance, in the shape that keeps this economy congruent with real spend authority.

priorities.statement: What a grant may be redeemed for, and until when, is authored with the grant rather than after it.
A rule's effect is stated in plain language before it is saved.
priorities.notes: A minter who cannot predict what a rule will refuse will write rules that surprise a child.

priorities.statement: Issuing a grant records why, because the reason reaches the holder's history.

states.description: No grants yet; the page explains that earning adapters also produce grants.

Grant or rule rejected, naming the constraint.
Grants loaded but attached rules failed to resolve; grants render with rules marked unavailable rather than appearing rule-free.
Showing cached grants after a failed refresh, labelled as such so an expired grant is not read as active.
